'''Arrow Squadron''' was a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] formed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] consisted of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. The squadron participated in the [[Battle of Lanteeb|Mission to Lanteeb]], where it took casualties against the opposing [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]].

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the squadron was assigned to the Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Coruscant Sky]]'' and flew [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]]. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. The squadron participated in the Mission to Lanteeb where a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|flotilla]] engaged a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] fleet led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The pilots of Arrow Squadron were used in a deception during the course of the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] engagement, chasing a Separatist spy ship piloted by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was attempting to infiltrate the planet and stop General [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] and his bio-weapon. Arrow Squadron engaged the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] while pilots of [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] harassed the spy ship. The ruse was successful and the Jedi Master landed on the planet.

After fourteen hours of engaging the Separatist fleet, Arrow Squadron had lost a quarter of its complement. The battle ended a few hours later when a corporate fleet put together by [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] arrived over [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]], forcing Grievous to flee.

==Behind the scenes==
Arrow Squadron appears in the [[2010]] novel ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''.
